name: akm-desktop
description: A local workspace for reviewing and maintaining agent knowledge.
author: fwdslsh

scripts.test: node --test tests/runtime.test.mjs tests/ui-helpers.test.mjs tests/editor-commands.test.mjs tests/editor-preview.test.mjs tests/library-files-model.test.mjs tests/software.test.mjs tests/menu-install.test.mjs tests/home-model.test.mjs tests/integration-contract.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e: node --test --test-concurrency=2 tests/e2e.test.mjs tests/library-content.test.mjs tests/library-parity.test.mjs tests/review-parity.test.mjs tests/activity-settings-parity.test.mjs tests/workspace.test.mjs tests/editor-workflows.test.mjs tests/library-files-workflow.test.mjs tests/navigation-startup.test.mjs tests/software-ui.test.mjs tests/asset-management.test.mjs tests/asset-management-ui.test.mjs tests/sensitive-assets.test.mjs tests/file-management.test.mjs tests/home.test.mjs
scripts.package: npm run prepare:core && npm run build && node scripts/package.mjs
scripts.appimage: npm run prepare:core && npm run build && node scripts/package.mjs --appimage
